title: Rabbi Chanina son of Rabbi Abba
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 23:5: he interpreted the verse as referring to the kingdoms: “Just as this rose, when it is set among the thorns, a north wind comes out and bends it toward the south, and the thorn pricks it — yet its heart is directed upward — so Israel,” etc. Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:2 reads Rabbi Huna.
He is likewise mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 3:6: “Rabbi Chanina bar Abba went to a certain place,” etc.; Esther Rabbah 3:6 reads Rabbi Chanina bar Acha.

notes.text: The supplied במלגיות is understood as kingdoms from saved Torat Emet Vayikra Rabbah 23:5’s במלכיות. It does not mean rose-bush. The rose simile, supplied abbreviated extent and Huna/Chanina variant remain distinct; וגן is read as וכן.
